correctness.rationale: Two exhaustive independent face enumerators match on 23,625 augmented simplices; full reversed-Hasse topological sort passes on all 124,200 incidences, proving acyclic Morse matching with one ordinary critical vertex, 47 five-cells, 182 six-cells. Two independent integral gradient-path algorithms compute equal 47-by-182 signed attaching matrices. Explicit integer row/column elementary operations give 43 unit pivots and an identically zero 4-by-139 remainder. In the simply connected two-level CW model with lowest positive cells in dimension five, all attaching maps are classified by their degrees, so CW cancellations prove the wedge of four 5-spheres and 139 6-spheres. Standalone verifier executed from its actual path with all assertions passing; no claims about larger cubes.
